ShortDescription.Value: A WriteEverywhere-Module that replaces Vanilla Signs with Polish ones.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Polish Vanilla Theme Overrider
Hello and Cześć. This is a **EU** and **NA** Vanilla Theme Overrider that turns Vanilla Signs, Roadmarkings and Decals to Polish ones.
## Functions - Works **automaticly**, you don't need any knowledge whatsoever! - Dynamic working Street Signs - Dynamic working Bus/Tram Signs with max. 7 Lines displayed - Bicycle Parking Spots - 3D Model Signs
## Requirements - [Write Everywhere](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/92908/Windows) – required
## Soft Requirements - [Station Entrance Visuals by rodrigmatrix](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/95823/Windows) - for Detailed Station Line listing
## Credits and Special Thanks - To **Klyte45** for the WriteEverywhere mod. - **Klyte45**s [Vanilla Theme Override Mod](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/106877/Windows), without that I would have lost my mind. - **kstsk** for the implementation of an working line-listing on Station Stops
## Enjoy & Share Your Feedback!
